name: Perpetual IP Transfer
description: Client retains permanent, global, irrevocable ownership of all creative work and intellectual property produced under the agreement, including future derivative works.

name: Exclusivity Trap
description: The agreement prohibits the creator or agency from working with competing brands, similar industries, or any clients in the same niche during or after the contract period.

name: Broad Indemnification Clause
description: The service provider agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the client from any and all claims, damages, losses, or liabilities including those not directly caused by the provider.

name: Unlimited Revisions
description: The contract requires the provider to make unlimited revisions or changes to deliverables without additional compensation or a defined revision limit.

name: Hidden Auto-Renewal
description: The agreement automatically renews for an extended period without explicit written notice from the client, creating ongoing financial obligations.

name: Unilateral Contract Modification
description: The client reserves the right to modify, amend, or change the terms of the contract at any time without the provider's consent.

name: No-Kill-Fee Termination
description: The client may terminate the contract at any time without paying a kill fee or compensation for work already completed or in progress.

name: Vague Deliverables
description: The scope of deliverables, services, or creative output is described in vague or ambiguous terms that could lead to scope creep.

name: Late Payment No Penalty
description: The agreement does not specify penalties or interest for late payments, leaving the provider with no recourse for delayed compensation.

name: Content Approval Bottleneck
description: Payment or project milestones are contingent on client approval without a defined approval timeline, potentially creating indefinite delays.

name: One-Sided Confidentiality
description: The NDA or confidentiality clause only restricts the service provider and does not equally protect the provider's proprietary methods, strategies, or business information.

name: Forced Arbitration
description: The agreement requires any disputes to be resolved through private arbitration, waiving the right to a jury trial or class action.

name: Subcontracting Restrictions
description: The provider is prohibited from subcontracting any portion of the work without prior written approval, limiting operational flexibility.

name: Extended Payment Terms
description: The payment schedule extends beyond 30 days net, creating cash flow risk for the provider.

name: Short Termination Notice
description: The termination notice period is very short (less than 14 days), leaving insufficient time to wind down or transition work.

name: Portfolio Usage Restriction
description: The client restricts the provider from displaying completed work in their portfolio or using it as a case study without prior written approval.
